correctness.rationale: For two sites Y=(b,-b), known noise h>0 and signal variance1, exact diagonalization yields L(t)=2z/(A-t)+ln(A²-t²), A=1+h, z=b². For A>=2 compare L(t)-L(0)=2t[z-J_A(t)]/[A(A-t)]; series derivative shows J_A strictly increasing to J_A(1)=kappa(h). Differentiation gives derivative sign from q(t)=t²+(z-A)t+Az, excluding hidden interior minima if z<kappa, including z=0 and tie z=kappa. Series S(u) proves kappa strictly increasing from ln(4/3) toward 1/2. For ALL h>0 the bound J_A(t)<t/[2(1+t/A)]<1/2 forces t=0 when z>=1/2. Endpoints are compactification limits, never positive finite lengthscales under assumed kernel continuity/strict interior t. Independent numerical endpoint, tie and derivative calculations corroborate not exhaust the continuum.
residual_risks: Fixed two sites opposite residuals, mean and marginal signal variance and h known; t endpoints correspond only to lengthscale limits and may not be finite. Middle-signal h<1 not globally classified.
